632:     if N != M:
633:         raise ValueError(
634:             "Chord comparison received different length lists: "
635:             "len(reference)=%d\tlen(estimates)=%d" % (N, M)
636:         )
637:     for labels in [reference_labels, estimated_labels]:
638:         for chord_label in labels:
639:             validate_chord_label(chord_label)
640:     # When either label list is empty, warn the user
641:     if len(reference_labels) == 0:
642:         warnings.warn("Reference labels are empty")
643:     if len(estimated_labels) == 0:
644:         warnings.warn("Estimated labels are empty")
645: 
646: 
647: def weighted_accuracy(comparisons, weights):
648:     """Compute the weighted accuracy of a list of chord comparisons.
649: 
650:     Examples
651:     --------
652:     >>> (ref_intervals,
653:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
654:     >>> (est_intervals,
655:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
656:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
657:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
658:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
659:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
660:     >>> (intervals,
661:     ...  ref_labels,
662:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
663:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
664:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
665:     >>> # Here, we're using the "thirds" function to compare labels
666:     >>> # but any of the comparison functions would work.
667:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.thirds(ref_labels, est_labels)
668:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
669: 
670:     Parameters
671:     ----------
672:     comparisons : np.ndarray
673:         List of chord comparison scores, in [0, 1] or -1
674:     weights : np.ndarray
675:         Weights (not necessarily normalized) for each comparison.
676:         This can be a list of interval durations
677: 
678:     Returns
679:     -------
680:     score : float
681:         Weighted accuracy
682: 
683:     """
684:     N = len(comparisons)
685:     # There should be as many weights as comparisons
686:     if weights.shape[0] != N:
687:         raise ValueError(
688:             "weights and comparisons should be of the same"
689:             " length. len(weights) = {} but len(comparisons)"
690:             " = {}".format(weights.shape[0], N)
691:         )
692:     if (weights < 0).any():
693:         raise ValueError("Weights should all be positive.")
694:     if np.sum(weights) == 0:
695:         warnings.warn("No nonzero weights, returning 0")
696:         return 0
697:     # Find all comparison scores which are valid
698:     valid_idx = comparisons >= 0
699:     # If no comparable chords were provided, warn and return 0
700:     if valid_idx.sum() == 0:
701:         warnings.warn(
702:             "No reference chords were comparable " "to estimated chords, returning 0."
703:         )
704:         return 0
705:     # Remove any uncomparable labels
706:     comparisons = comparisons[valid_idx]
707:     weights = weights[valid_idx]
708:     # Normalize the weights
709:     total_weight = float(np.sum(weights))
710:     normalized_weights = np.asarray(weights, dtype=float) / total_weight
711:     # Score is the sum of all weighted comparisons
712:     return np.sum(comparisons * normalized_weights)
713: 
714: 
715: def thirds(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
716:     """Compare chords along root & third relationships.
717: 
718:     Examples
719:     --------
720:     >>> (ref_intervals,
721:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
722:     >>> (est_intervals,
723:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
724:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
725:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
726:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
727:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
728:     >>> (intervals,
729:     ...  ref_labels,
730:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
731:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
732:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
733:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.thirds(ref_labels, est_labels)
734:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
735: 
736:     Parameters
737:     ----------
738:     reference_labels : list, len=n
739:         Reference chord labels to score against.
740:     estimated_labels : list, len=n
741:         Estimated chord labels to score against.
742: 
743:     Returns
744:     -------
745:     comparison_scores : np.ndarray, shape=(n,), dtype=float
746:         Comparison scores, in [0.0, 1.0]
747: 
748:     """
749:     validate(reference_labels, estimated_labels)
750:     ref_roots, ref_semitones = encode_many(reference_labels, False)[:2]
751:     est_roots, est_semitones = encode_many(estimated_labels, False)[:2]
752: 
753:     eq_roots = ref_roots == est_roots
754:     eq_thirds = ref_semitones[:, 3] == est_semitones[:, 3]
755:     comparison_scores = (eq_roots * eq_thirds).astype(np.float64)
756: 
757:     # Ignore 'X' chords
758:     comparison_scores[np.any(ref_semitones < 0, axis=1)] = -1.0
759:     return comparison_scores
760: 
761: 
762: def thirds_inv(reference_labels, estimated_labels):
763:     """Score chords along root, third, & bass relationships.
764: 
765:     Examples
766:     --------
767:     >>> (ref_intervals,
768:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
769:     >>> (est_intervals,
770:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
771:     >>> est_intervals, est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
772:     ...     est_intervals, est_labels, ref_intervals.min(),
773:     ...     ref_intervals.max(), mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD,
774:     ...     mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD)
775:     >>> (intervals,
776:     ...  ref_labels,
777:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(
778:     ...      ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels)
779:     >>> durations = mir_eval.util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
780:     >>> comparisons = mir_eval.chord.thirds_inv(ref_labels, est_labels)
781:     >>> score = mir_eval.chord.weighted_accuracy(comparisons, durations)
782: 
783:     Parameters
784:     ----------
785:     reference_labels : list, len=n
786:         Reference chord labels to score against.
787:     estimated_labels : list, len=n
